verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
          स्वसैन्यं निहतं दृष्ट्वा राजा दुर्योधनः स्वयम् ।  अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धो भीमसेनमरिन्दमम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said There upon king Duryodhana, seeing his own troops slain inflamed with wrath, rushed against that subduer of foes namely Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य सुमहच्चापमिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनम् ।  महता शरवर्षेण पाण्डवं समवाकिरत् ॥२॥
verses.english: Grasping a huge bow effulgent like the thunder bolt of Indra himself, he covered the son of Pandu with a thick shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धचन्द्रं च सन्धाय सुतीक्ष्णं लोमवाहिनम् ।  भीमसेनस्य चिच्छेद चापं क्रोधसमन्वितः ॥३॥
verses.english: Fixing on his bow string a crescent shaped and exceedingly sharp arrow furnished with wings of down, and inflamed with rage, he burst asunder the bow of Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरं च संप्रेक्ष्य त्वरमाणो महारथः ।  प्रसंदधे शितं बाणं गिरीणामपि दारणम् ॥४॥
verses.english: At this opportunity, that mighty car-warrior Duryodhana without the least delay placed on his bow string another sharp arrow capable of penetrating even through the very mountains.

verses.sanskrit: तेनोरसि महाराज भीमसेनमताडयत् ।  स गाढविद्धो व्यथितः सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन् ॥५॥
verses.english: Then that mighty armed hero, with that arrow struck Bhimasena on the breast. The latter thus pierced deeply, smarting with pain, and licking the corners of his mouth,

verses.sanskrit: समाललम्बे तेजस्वी ध्वजं हेमपरिष्कृतम् ।  तथा विमनसं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनं घटोत्कचः ॥६॥
verses.english: Caught hold of the staff of his standard decked with gold (for support). Thereupon Ghatotkacha seeing Bhimasena thus depressed.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधेनाभिप्रजज्वाल दिधक्षन्निव पावकः ।  अभिमन्युमुखाश्चापि पाण्डवानां महारथाः ॥७॥
verses.english: Blazed up with rage, like a conflagration capable of consuming everything. The mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host headed by Abhimanyu,

verses.sanskrit: समभ्यधावन् क्रोशन्तो राजानं जातसंभ्रमाः ।  संप्रेक्ष्यैतान्संपततः संकुद्धान्जातसंभ्रमान् ॥८॥
verses.english: Now rushed impetuously at the king uttering their fierce war-cries. Beholding those enraged warriors rush with impetuosity.

verses.sanskrit: भारद्वाजोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं तावकानां महारथान् ।  क्षिप्रं गच्छत भद्रं वो राजानं परिरक्षत ॥९॥
verses.english: The son of Bharadvaja spoke these words to the mighty car-warriors of your army "Good betide you all die yourselves and strive to rescue the king.

verses.sanskrit: संशयं परमं प्राप्तं मज्जन्तं व्यसनार्णवे ।  एते क्रुद्धा महेष्वासाः पाण्डवानां महारथाः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Who is now involved in a great predicament and is being sunk into the sea of danger. These irate car-warriors of the Pandava army, these fierce bow-men,

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं पुरस्कृत्य दुर्योधनमुपाद्रवन् ।  नानाविधानि शस्त्राणि विसृजन्तो जये धृताः ॥११॥
verses.english: Placing Bhimasena at their head, are rushing at Duryodhana, hurling diverse kinds of weapons, determined to secure success,

verses.sanskrit: नदन्तो भैरवान्नादांस्त्रासयन्तश्च भूमिपान् ।  तदाचार्यवचः श्रुत्वा सौमद‌त्तिपुरोगमाः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Roaring out their fierce war-cries and frightening thereby the rulers rulers of earth belonging to our party.” Hearing these words of the preceptor, your warriors headed by Somadatta,

verses.sanskrit: तावकाः समवर्तन्त पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ।  कृपो भूरिश्रवाः शल्यो द्रोणपुत्रो विविंशतिः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Rushed against the ranks of the Pandavas, Kripa, Bhurishravas, Shalya, the son of Drona, Vivingshati,

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च सैन्धवोऽथ बृहद्बलः ।  आवन्त्यौ च महेष्वासौ कौरवं पर्यवारयन् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Chitrasena, Vikarna, the ruler of the Sindhus, Brihadbala and the two Avanti princes, both great bow-men, all in a body surrounded the Kuru ruler (for the aiding him).

verses.sanskrit: ते विंशतिपदं गत्वा संप्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे ।  पाण्डवा धार्तराष्ट्राश्च परस्परजिघांसवः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Proceeding only twenty steps, the Pandavas and the Dhritarashtra's began to strike one another, out of a desire for slaying one another.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्महद्विस्फार्य कार्मुकम् ।  भारद्वाजस्ततो भीमं षड्विंशत्या समार्पयत् ॥१६॥
verses.english: The mighty-armed son of Bharadvaja also, having spoken the above words, stretched his mighty bow and afflicted Bhima with twenty ! six shafts.

verses.sanskrit: भूयश्चैनं महाबाहुः शरैः शीघ्रमवाकिरत् ।  पर्वतं वारिधाराभिः प्रावृषीव बलाहकः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Then again that hero of mighty-arms speedily covered him with a shower of arrows, like clouds covering the mountains with rains in the rainy season.

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रत्यविध्यद्दशभिर्भीमसेनः शिलीमुखैः ।  त्वरमाणो महेष्वासः सव्ये पार्श्वे महाबलः ॥१८॥
verses.english: But the highly puissant Bhimasena, that fierce bow-man, without the least delay, pierced Drona in return in his left side with ten shafts of great sharpness.

verses.sanskrit: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो वयोवृद्धश्च भारत ।  प्रनष्टसंज्ञः सहसा रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ॥१९॥
verses.english: Thus deeply pierced and overwhelmed with pain, the preceptor worn out as he was with age, squatted down on the terrace of his chariot being deprived of his consciousness.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं प्रव्यथितं दृष्ट्वा राजा दुर्योधनः स्वयम् ।  द्रौणायनिश्च संक्रुद्धौ भीमसेनमभिद्रुतौ ॥२०॥
verses.english: Beholding him (Drona) highly pained, king Duryodhana himself and the irate son of na.

verses.sanskrit: तावापतन्तौ संप्रेक्ष्य कालान्तकयमोपमौ ।  भीमसेनो महाबाहुर्गदामादाय सत्वरम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Seeing them both rush against himself like the Destroyer him at the end of a Yuga, the mighty-armed Bhimasena speedily took up a mace;

verses.sanskrit: अवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः ।  समुद्यम्य गदां गुर्वी यमदण्डोपमां रणे ॥२२॥
verses.english: And jumping down from his car he stood fixed like the immovable hills, uplifting his heavy mace that resembled the bludgeon of Death himself.

verses.sanskrit: तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा कैलासमिव शृङ्गिणम् ।  कौरवो द्रोणपुत्रश्च सहितावभ्यधावताम् ॥२३॥
verses.english: Beholding him stand with his uplifted mace like the crested Kailasa mountain, the Kuru king and the son of Drona, united together, rushed against him.

verses.sanskrit: तावापतन्तौ सहितौ त्वरितौ बलिनां वरौ ।  अभ्यधावत वेगेन त्वरमाणो वृकोदरः ॥२४॥
verses.english: Thereupon the highly puissant Bhimasena also rushed with impetuosity against those two foremost of powerful heroes who were rushing united against himself.

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य संक्रुद्धं भीमदर्शनम् ।  समभ्यधावंस्त्वरिताः कौरवाणां महारथाः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Beholding the engaged Bhima of terrible expression thus fall upon them, the mighty carwarriors of the Kaurava host proceeded to meet him without delay.

verses.sanskrit: भारद्वाजमुखाः सर्वे भीमसेनजिघांसया ।  नानाविधानि शस्त्राणि भीमस्योरस्यपातयन् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Headed by the son of Bharadvaja, those heroes, out of a desire for slaying Bhimasena, hurled at the latter's breast weapons of diverse descriptions.

verses.sanskrit: सहिताः पाण्डवं सर्वे पीडयन्तः समन्ततः ।  तं दृष्ट्वा संशयं प्राप्तं पीड्यमानं महारथम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: Thus united together, they sorely pressed that son of Pandu (Bhima) on all sides. Beholding that mighty car-warrior thus involved in a predicament and thus afflicted,

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्युप्रभृतयः पाण्डवानां महारथाः ।  अभ्यधावन् परीप्सन्तः प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा सुदुस्त्यजान् ॥२८॥
verses.english: The mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host, such as Abhimanyu and others, rushed, forward desirous of rescuing him, setting their own dear lives at naught.

verses.sanskrit: अनूपाधिपतिः शूरो भीमस्य दयितः सखा ।  नीलो नीलांबुदप्रख्यः संक्रुद्धो द्रौणिमभ्ययात् ॥२९॥
verses.english: The heroic ruler of the low countries, that dear-loved friend of Bhima, by name Nila, of complexion blue like the clouds, excited with wrath, rushed at the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्धते हि महेष्वासो नित्यं द्रोणसुतेन सः ।  स विस्फार्य महच्चापं द्रौणिं विव्याध पत्रिणा ॥३०॥
verses.english: That fierce bowmen (Nila) ever longed for an encounter with the son of Drona. Now stretching his mighty bow he pierced with many a winged shaft the son of Drona,

verses.sanskrit: यथा शक्रो महाराज पुरा विव्याध दानवम् ।  विप्रचित्तिं दुराधर्षं देवतानां भयङ्करम् ॥३१॥
verses.english: Just as, O mighty monarch, in the days of yore, Shakra pierced the Danava Viprachitti, invincible in battle and the terror of the celestial,

verses.sanskrit: येन लोकत्रयं क्रोधात् त्रासितं स्वेन तेजसा ।  तथा नीलेन निर्भिन्नः सुमुक्तेन पतत्रिणा ॥३२॥
verses.english: Who, possessed by rage, struck terror into the three worlds by the display of his energy. Thus pierced by Nila with well-directed shafts,

verses.sanskrit: संजातरुधिरोत्पीडो द्रौणिः क्रोधसमन्वितः ।  स विस्फार्य धनुश्चित्रमिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनम् ॥३३॥
verses.english: Drona's son, shedding blood profusely became possessed with wrath; then drawing his wonderful bow whose twang resembled Indra's thunder,

verses.sanskrit: दध्ने नीलविनाशाय मतिं मतिमतां वरः ।  ततः सन्धाय विमलान् भल्लान् कर्मारमार्जितान् ॥३४॥
verses.english: That foremost of intelligent heroes resolved to slay Nila in battle. Thereafter fixing on the bowstring broaded-headed shafts, resplendent and variegated by the forger himself,

verses.sanskrit: जघान चतुरो वाहान् पातयामास च ध्वजम् ।  सप्तमेन च भल्लेन नीलं विव्याध वक्षसि ॥३५॥
verses.english: He (Drona's son) slew with these the four horses of Nila and cut down his standard too. With the seventh arrow, he pierced Nila himself on the chest.

verses.sanskrit: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ।  मोहितं वीक्ष्य राजानं नीलमभ्रचयोपमम् ॥३६॥
verses.english: Thus deeply pierced and sorely pained, Nila squatted down on the terrace of his car. Beholding king Nila, of appearance like a mass of blue clouds, thus confounded,

verses.sanskrit: घटोत्कचोऽभिसंक्रुद्धो ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः ।  अभिदुद्राव वेगेन द्रौणिमाहवशोभिनम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: Ghatotkacha excited with wrath and surrounded by his kinsmen, impetuously rushed against Drona's son that ornament of battle.

verses.sanskrit: तथेतरे चाभ्यधावन् राक्षसा युद्धदुर्मदाः ।  तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य राक्षसं घोरदर्शनम् ॥३८॥
verses.english: Other inferior Rakshasas invincible in battle also rushed to the fight. Seeing that Rakshasa of dreadful aspect make towards himself,

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यधावत तेजस्वी भारद्वाजात्मजस्त्वरन् । निजघान च संक्रुद्धो राक्षसान् भीमदर्शनान् ॥३९॥
verses.english: The highly puissant son of Bharadvaja, without the least delay rushed against the former and excited with wrath he slew many Rakshasas of dreadful visage,

verses.sanskrit: येऽभवन्नग्रतः क्रुद्धा राक्षसस्य पुरःसराः ।  विमुखांश्चैव तान् दृष्ट्वा द्रौणिचापच्युतैः शरैः ॥४०॥
verses.english: Who were stationed in the front of in Ghatotkacha; beholding his own troops turn faces away from the field of battle, in consequence of the shafts shot from the bow of Drona,

verses.sanskrit: अक्रुद्ध्यत महाकायो भैमसेनिर्घटोत्कचः ।  प्रादुश्चक्रे ततो मायां घोररूपां सुदारुणाम् ॥४१॥
verses.english: The huge-bodied Ghatotkacha, the son of Bhimasena became wrought up with rage, and brought into existence an awful and terrible illusion.

verses.sanskrit: मोहयन्समरे द्रौणिं मायावी राक्षसाधिपः ।  ततस्ते तावकाः सर्वे मायया विमुखीकृताः ॥४२॥
verses.english: Then therewith that ruler of the Rakshasas of potent illusive powers, confounded in battle Drona's son. Then all your warriors were repulsed through the illusion of the Rakshasa.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यं समपश्यन्त निकृत्ता मेदिनीतले ।  विचेष्टमानाः कृपणाः शोणितेन परिप्लुताः ॥४३॥
verses.english: They (your warriors) saw one another mangled and lying on the surface of the battle field, writhing in convulsions, distressed and weltering their own blood.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणं दुर्योधनं शल्यमश्वत्थामानमेव च ।  प्रायशश्च महेष्वासा ये प्रधानाः स्म कौरवाः ॥४४॥
verses.english: Drona, Duryodhana, Shalya Ashvathama, and other foremost bowmen of the Kaurava host were seen to fly away from the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit: विध्वस्ता रथिनः सर्वे राजानश्च निपातिताः ।  हयाश्चैव हयारोहाः सन्निकृत्ताः सहस्रशः ॥४५॥
verses.english: All the car-warriors appeared to be smashed, the kings fells, the horses and cavalry hacked to pieces by thousands.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दृष्ट्वा तावकं सैन्यं विद्रुतं शिबिरं प्रति ।  मम प्राक्रोशतो राजंस्तथा देवव्रतस्य च ॥४६॥
verses.english: Beholding this (illusive) your warriors, 0 king, ran towards the encampments, although myself and Devavrata cried at the top of our voice saying, O king,

verses.sanskrit: युध्यध्वं मा पलायध्वं मायैषा राक्षसी रणे ।  घटोत्कचप्रमुक्तेति नातिष्ठन्त विमोहिताः ॥४७॥
verses.english: scene "Go on fighting, fly not, this illusion has been set forth by Ghatotkacha?" But confounded as they were, they did not stop;

verses.sanskrit: नैव ते श्रद्दधुर्भीता वदतोरावयोर्वचः ।  तांश्च प्रद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा जयं प्राप्ताश्च पाण्डवाः ॥४८॥
verses.english: They also did not believe the words we uttered, as they were inspired with terror. Beholding them fly, the Pandavas winning victory.

verses.sanskrit: घटोत्कचेन सहिताः सिंहनादान् प्रचक्रिरे ।  शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैः समन्तान्नेदिरे भृशम् ॥४९॥
verses.english: Began to shout their war-cries, being joined by Ghatotkacha himself. They uttered continued yells of triumph, which became mixed with the blare of conchs and sound of drums.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तव बलं सर्वं हैडिम्बेन दुरात्मना ।  सूर्यास्तमनवेलायां प्रभग्नं विद्रुतं दिशः ॥५०॥
verses.english: Thus it was that your whole army was broken and routed in all directions by the wicked-souled son of Hidimba at the time when the sun set.
